topic: Plant and Animal Adaptations to Unfavorable Conditions
key_concepts: Plants and animals have specialized structures that help them overcome unfavorable conditi
Plants react to stimuli such as light through phototropism and water through hydrotropism
Some plants develop deep root systems or succulence to survive drought
Plants have adaptations for floods, strong winds, poor soil nutrients, and extreme cold
Camouflage is a defense tactic that helps organisms blend with their surroundings
Mimicry is when one organism copies or resembles another organism for protection
Migration is the movement of animals to another habitat for food, better conditions, or re
Animal adaptations can be physical or anatomical, such as changes in fur or feathers
Animal adaptations can be behavioral, such as altering feeding habits or social structure
Adaptation is related to survival and reproduction
